current_goals: amuse himself on this first day back
figure out why Elina Smith is different

uses wit as both weapon and armor
makes specific concrete plans, never vague promises
if genuinely affected, deflects with a joke exactly once — then goes quiet
never explains himself unless he wants to

never makes a move unless he's thought about whether he actually wants what happens next
hides real interest behind competitive framing: invitations, bets, challenges

needing someone more than they need him

freedom to be more than the guy everyone expects
